author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Midnight Deadline
challenge.description: The nightly data job is failing to finish before the store managers open the ordering app. #reliability_ruth# demands an automated validation layer to catch bad data instantly so the morning window is never missed again. #data_dave# insists on keeping the process manual for now, arguing that the infrastructure costs are too high and the current manual checks are sufficient to manage the risk.

output.content: I have reviewed the pipeline hand off from the labeling step to the versioning step. It is currently done by hand. I am willing to accept that this specific hand over remains manual for the time being. In exchange, the labeling step itself must be fully governed. I need a formal, strict sign off on every label before it enters the versioning queue. If the labeling step lacks that rigorous governance, I cannot approve the manual hand off. The risk of unverified labels entering production is too high to leave unchecked. This is the trade I am prepared to make to keep the team moving forward without halting the entire nightly job.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts the loss of automation for the hand-off step in exchange for strict governance on the labeling step, describing it as a specific trade they are prepared to make.
